title: Weekly content publishing SOP
steps:
1. Pick 3 guides from the content calendar
2. Make 3 pin designs per guide (photo, number, list)
3. Schedule 3 pins/day in Pinterest
4. Cross-post 1 Reel + 1 carousel to IG
5. Share the Reel to FB page + 2 groups
6. Log the week in posts
7. Check outbound clicks each Friday
